# CLAUDE.md — Light Project

## Build & Dev Commands

```sh
just install          # npm install --ignore-scripts
just dev              # Vite dev server on :8080
just build            # Production build → dist/
node --require ./scripts/fix-noexec.cjs ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
```

Always run a build after editing source files to confirm no import/syntax errors.

## Architecture

**Single-page app, no framework.** All DOM is generated by `src/main.js` at runtime; `index.html` is an empty shell. UI state lives in plain JS variables — no reactive system.

### Key files

| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `src/main.js` | Builds DOM, manages tab selection, wires sliders/preset buttons, owns `scenes` Map and `paramState` Map |
| `src/scenes.js` | One factory function per light type; all return `{ start, stop, setParam, dispose }` |
| `src/data.js` | `LIGHT_DATA` array — all copy, params, inline SVGs, math strings |
| `src/ui.js` | `initModals(lights, getCurrentId)` — wires the three modals (math 💡, anatomy, compare) |
| `src/style.css` | Full styles; variables at `:root`; no CSS-in-JS |

### Scene lifecycle

Each light type has its own `WebGLRenderer` + `OrbitControls`. Scenes are **lazy-created** on first tab selection and cached in the `scenes` Map. The `IntersectionObserver` in earlier versions was removed; scenes are now started/stopped directly on tab switch in `selectLight()`.

`mkBase()` in `scenes.js` is the shared setup (renderer, camera, sphere, ground, grid, OrbitControls, resize handler). Every scene factory calls it and adds its own lights, helpers, and annotation arrows.

### Adding a new parameter to an existing light

1. Add an entry to the `params` array in `LIGHT_DATA[n]` in `src/data.js`.
2. Handle the param id in the `mkRunner` callback inside the matching factory in `src/scenes.js`.
3. That's it — `main.js` reads `params` dynamically to render the slider/preset UI and wire events.

### Adding a new light type

1. Add a full entry to `LIGHT_DATA` in `src/data.js` (id, name, params, table, SVGs, math copy).
2. Write a factory `mkFoo(canvas)` in `src/scenes.js` that calls `mkBase`, adds lights/meshes, and returns `mkRunner(base, onParam)`.
3. Register it in the `FACTORIES` map at the bottom of `src/scenes.js`.

## Annotation arrows

`mkArrow(dir, origin, length, color, opacity)` in `scenes.js` wraps `THREE.ArrowHelper` with transparent materials and a custom `setColor(c)` method. Arrows are added to a `THREE.Group` so they can be repositioned or rotated together with the light.

## NixOS noexec

`scripts/fix-noexec.cjs` is `--require`d before every Vite invocation. It copies `esbuild` and any `.node` native modules to `/tmp` so they can execute on `noexec`-mounted partitions. Do not skip it.

## Color palette

Defined as CSS custom properties in `src/style.css`:

```
--void   #08090C   page background
--ink    #111318   card / modal background
--mist   #6B7280   secondary text
--chalk  #E8EAF0   primary text
--accent #7B61FF   interactive highlight
--warm   #FFAA44   light-source warm colour
```

## Deployment

`vite.config.js` sets `base: '/Light/'` for GitHub Pages. The GitHub Actions workflow (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`) triggers on push to `main`, runs `npm ci && npm run build`, and uploads `dist/` via `actions/upload-pages-artifact`.
